sn22.85:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn22.85:1.2: tena kho pana samayena yamakassa nāma bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti
sn22.85:1.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ, desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā’ti.
sn22.85:2.1: assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū yamakassa kira nāma bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
sn22.85:2.2: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā”ti.
sn22.85:2.3: atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā yamako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā yamakena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
sn22.85:2.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ yamakaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.85:3.1: “saccaṃ kira te āvuso yamaka, evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
sn22.85:3.2: “tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā”ti.
sn22.85:3.3: evaṃ kho’haṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā
sn22.85:3.4: khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā’ti.
sn22.85:4.1: mā āvuso, yamaka evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi. na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya:
sn22.85:4.2: “khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā”ti.
sn22.85:4.3: evampi kho āyasmā yamako tehi bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva taṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati
sn22.85:4.4: “tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.”
sn22.85:5.1: yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu āyasmantaṃ yamakaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ. athakho te bhikkhū uṭṭhāyāsanā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.85:5.2: yamakassa nāma āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
sn22.85:5.3: “tathā’haṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā’ti.
sn22.85:5.4: sādhāyasmā sāriputto yena yamako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
sn22.85:5.6: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā yamako tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā yamakena saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ yamakaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.85:6.1: saccaṃ kira te āvuso yamaka, evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ?
sn22.85:6.2: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā”ti. evañca
sn22.85:6.3: khohaṃ āvuso, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi: “yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇā”ti.
sn22.85:7.4: “yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti? dukkhaṃ āvuso. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ “etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā”ti? no hetaṃ āvuso, vedanā …pe…
sn22.85:7.9: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti? dukkhaṃ āvuso. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti? no hetaṃ āvuso. tasmātihāvuso yamaka, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ “netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na me’so attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. yā kāci vedanā …pe… yā kāci saññā …pe… ye keci saṅkhārā …pe… yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ “netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā”ti, evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.85:7.10: evaṃ passaṃ āvuso yamaka, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati …pe…
sn22.85:11.2: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgatoti samanupassasīti.
sn22.85:11.4: taṃ kiṃ maññasi āvuso, yamaka, rūpaṃ …pe… vedanaṃ …pe… saññaṃ …pe… saṅkhāre …pe… viññāṇaṃ tathāgato’ti samanupassasīti? no hetaṃ āvuso. ettha ca te āvuso yamaka diṭṭheva dhamme saccato thetato tathāgate anupalabbhiyamāne kallaṃ nu te taṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ
sn22.85:11.5: “tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti?
sn22.85:12.1: ahu kho metaṃ āvuso sāriputta, pubbe aviddasuno pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ
sn22.85:12.2: idañca pana me āyasmato sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā tañceva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ pahīnaṃ, dhammo ca me abhisametoti.
sn22.85:13.1: sace taṃ āvuso yamaka, evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
sn22.85:13.2: “yo so āvuso yamaka, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā kiṃ hotīti
sn22.85:13.3: evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ āvuso yamaka, kinti byākareyyāsī”ti?
sn22.85:13.5: “yo so āvuso yamaka, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā kiṃ hotī”ti?
sn22.85:14.2: tenahāvuso yamaka, upamante karissāmi etasseva atthassa bhiyyosomattāya ñāṇāya.
sn22.85:14.3: seyyathāpi āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo,
sn22.85:14.5: tassa kocideva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetukāmo.
sn22.85:14.7: “ayaṃ kho gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo,
sn22.85:14.9: na vyā sukaro pasayha jīvitā voropetuṃ.
sn22.85:14.11: so taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
sn22.85:14.13: tamenaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya.
sn22.85:14.14: so upaṭṭhaheyya pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī.
sn22.85:14.15: tassa so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā mittato’pi naṃ saddaheyya
sn22.85:14.18: yadā kho āvuso tassa purisassa evamassa:
sn22.85:14.19: “saṃvissaṭṭho kho myāyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vāti.” atha naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropeyya.
sn22.85:15.2: yadā’pi so puriso amuṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evamāha:
sn22.85:15.6: yadā’pi so upaṭṭhāti pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī. tadā’pi so vadhakova.
sn22.85:15.9: yadā’pi naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitāvoropeti. tadā’pi so vadhakova.
sn22.85:15.13: evameva kho āvuso assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto,
sn22.85:15.14: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.85:15.18: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.85:16.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ ‘aniccaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:18.2: anattaṃ vedanaṃ anattā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:18.4: anatte saṅkhāre anattā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:18.5: anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattaṃ viññāṇa”nti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:19.1: saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ saṅkhataṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:19.2: saṅkhataṃ vedanaṃ saṅkhatā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:19.4: saṅkhate saṅkhāre saṅkhatā saṅkhārā”ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:19.5: saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:20.1: vadhakaṃ rūpaṃ vadhakaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:20.4: vadhake saṅkhāre …pe… vadhakā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:20.5: vadhakaṃ viññāṇaṃ vadhakaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:21.1: so rūpaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti ‘attā me’ti.
sn22.85:21.6: tassime pañcupādānakkhandhā upetā upādinnā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
sn22.85:22.1: sutavā ca kho āvuso ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.85:22.2: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.85:22.6: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ,
sn22.85:22.7: na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.85:23.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:23.5: aniccaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:24.1: dukkhaṃ rūpaṃ dukkhaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:24.5: dukkhaṃ viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:25.1: anattaṃ rūpaṃ anattā rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:25.5: anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattā viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:26.1: saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ saṅkhataṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:26.5: saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:27.1: vadhakaṃ rūpaṃ vadhakaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:27.5: vadhakaṃ viññāṇaṃ vadhakaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:28.1: so rūpaṃ na upeti, na upādiyati, na adhiṭṭhāti, attā meti.
sn22.85:28.5: viññāṇaṃ na upeti, na upādiyati, na adhiṭṭhāti attā me’ti.
sn22.85:28.6: tassime pañcupādānakkhandhā anupetā anupādinnā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti.
sn22.85:28.7: evametaṃ āvuso sāriputta hoti. yesaṃ āyasmantādisā sabrahmacārino anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā.
sn22.85:28.8: idañca pana me āyasmato sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
sn22.85:28.9: idamavoca āyasmā sāriputto. attamano āyasmā yamako āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
